messages.cli.digest.summary: Print the digest as it stands: everything that waits for you, in two groups (must decide for the work to go on, can wait), each with advice and a command. Reads the kingdom only, spends no mana.
messages.cli.digest.title: Digest {day} · {kingdom}
messages.cli.digest.counts: {must} to decide for the work to go on, {can_wait} that can wait.
messages.cli.digest.carried_red: Carried then red: {count} checks carried on the same tree failed at patrol; review K3/K7 of plans/recheck.md.
messages.cli.digest.group.must: Decide for the work to go on
messages.cli.digest.item.question: Quest {quest} «{title}» asks: {question}.
messages.cli.digest.item.awaiting_seal: Quest {quest} «{title}» (rank {rank}) waits for the royal seal.
messages.cli.digest.item.delivery_failed: The delivery of quest {quest} «{title}» stopped at {stage}: {why}
messages.cli.digest.item.judge_mana: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review, but every judge who may take it is out of mana ({gauges}).
messages.cli.digest.item.unjudgeable: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review, but the kingdom has nobody who may judge it.
messages.cli.digest.item.unjudgeable_vision: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review for a judge who reads images, and the kingdom has nobody who may judge it.
messages.cli.digest.item.judge_no_session: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review, but the session of its judge {judge} could not open (the Steward's log says why, on its «no session for {judge}» line).
messages.cli.digest.item.unclaimable: Quest {quest} «{title}» (rank {rank}) is one nobody can take.
messages.cli.digest.item.scope_wait: Quest {quest} «{title}» is open and waits for {holder}, whose scope meets its own at {overlap}.
messages.cli.digest.item.scope_held: Quest {quest} «{title}» is done but still holds its scope; {waiting} wait for it.
messages.cli.digest.item.draft: Draft quest {quest} «{title}» waits for your confirmation.
messages.cli.digest.item.memo: Memo {memo} ({memo_kind}) from {from}, of quest {quest}, waits for your decision.
messages.cli.digest.item.delivery_waits: The pull request of quest {quest} «{title}» is open for you ({url}).
messages.cli.digest.item.delivery_merging: The delivery of quest {quest} «{title}» stopped at {stage}; the merge quest {merge_quest} resolves it.
messages.cli.digest.item.base_red: Territory {territory}: check {check} of the default branch is red since {since} (commit {commit}): {error_line} Log: {log_path}. Quests merged since the last green patrol: {suspects}.{attributed}{stopped}
messages.cli.digest.item.patrol_scan: Territory {territory}: scan {script} of the latest patrol: {outcome}, {count} found.
messages.cli.digest.base_stopped: The territory takes no work; quests waiting for its default branch to be green: {count}.
messages.cli.digest.base_cause.own_change: The probe: the merge of quest {quest} (commit {commit}) is red on its own.
messages.cli.digest.base_cause.combination: The probe: quest {quest} and the branch before its merge (commit {commit}) are green apart, red together.
messages.cli.digest.base_cause.outside: The probe: commit {commit} turned it red, no quest's merge.
messages.cli.digest.base_cause.flaky: The probe: red, then green on the same commit {commit}: the check is flaky.
messages.cli.digest.base_cause.unknown: The probe could not say which commit turned it red.
messages.cli.digest.no_suspects: none (the change came from outside Elvaria)
messages.cli.digest.temple_reason.no_monk: no Monk who is not suspended
messages.cli.digest.item.memo_escalated: Letter {memo} ({memo_kind}) from {from}, of quest {quest}: the Chancellor advises: {triage}; it is yours to decide because {holds}.
messages.cli.digest.item.objection: Objection {memo} from {from}, of quest {quest}: no second judge may read it.
messages.cli.digest.item.mana_asleep: Pool {pool} of tribe {tribe} is out of mana (reset: {resets_at}).
messages.cli.digest.item.tribe_held: Tribe {tribe}: its CLI {path} now says {version}, not {checked_version}, the version its last check with the real CLI passed on; the Steward opens no new session for it.
messages.cli.digest.item.tribe_gone: Tribe {tribe}: the CLI its Steward starts, {path}, is gone (an update moved it?); the Steward opens no new session for it.
messages.cli.digest.item.upgrade_available: A newer build of Elvaria: {commits} commit(s) on main touch the code since the pinned {pinned} (main is at {latest}).
messages.cli.digest.item.narrow_escapes: Territory {territory}: {escapes} escaped check conclusions in the latest {merges} merges exceed 1 in 10 in narrow mode.
messages.cli.digest.advice.consider_full: Read the metrics and consider returning the territory to full checks: elvaria territory checks <territory> --mode full.
messages.cli.digest.item.character_suspended: {character} waits at the Temple after {count} fails in a row ({fail_kind}): no new line of scripture has freed it. The Monk's letters on its runs: {letters}.
messages.cli.digest.item.temple_no_monk: The Temple cannot run ({reasons}) while {count} kind(s) of failure repeat.
messages.cli.digest.item.temple_off: The Temple cannot run ({reasons}) while {count} kind(s) of failure repeat.
messages.cli.digest.item.merged_unsealed: The Steward merged quest {quest} «{title}» into the base branch of {territory} without the royal seal, by the delegation of the seal (pull request {url}, commit {commit}).
messages.cli.digest.item.delegation_suspended: The delegation of the seal on territory {territory} is suspended since {since}: {cause} (quest {quest} «{title}»).
messages.cli.digest.advice.answer: Answer, and the doer goes on.
messages.cli.digest.advice.seal_or_return: Read the work, then seal it, or return it with a note (elvaria return).
messages.cli.digest.advice.retry_or_archive: Read why (elvaria quest show), then retry it, or archive it if you drop it.
messages.cli.digest.advice.deliver_again: Once fixed, deliver it again: the Steward does not try again on its own.
messages.cli.digest.advice.judge_other_pool_or_wa: Wait for the reset, or summon a judge of another model on another mana pool.
messages.cli.digest.advice.summon_judge: Summon a judge on a model nobody who worked the quest used.
messages.cli.digest.advice.summon_judge_with_visi: Summon a judge of a tribe whose CLI reads images (its adapter declares vision), on a model nobody who worked the quest used.
messages.cli.digest.advice.suspend_judge_or_wait: Another judge takes it once free; each session that could not open counts toward the run's judges. If this judge's tribe cannot take work this size (a prompt longer than its CLI takes), suspend it until that is fixed.
messages.cli.digest.advice.see_why: Read why (elvaria quest show), then summon or level up a character, or edit the quest.
messages.cli.digest.advice.wait_for_scope: Not urgent: it starts by itself once that quest is archived.
messages.cli.digest.advice.merge_and_archive: Merge its branch: the Steward archives it at its next look at the base branch (within 10 minutes), and the quests that wait for its scope start.
messages.cli.digest.advice.confirm_or_cancel: Confirm it to open it, or cancel it (elvaria quest cancel).
messages.cli.digest.advice.decide_memo: Read the memo, then decide it once (elvaria memo decide).
messages.cli.digest.advice.merge_pr_and_archive: Read and merge the pull request on the forge: the Steward archives the quest and gives its plot back at its next look (within 10 minutes).
messages.cli.digest.advice.follow_merge_quest: A knight resolves it in the merge quest, which a judge reads and you seal; the quest goes into the base branch with it. Should you cancel that quest, deliver this one again yourself.
messages.cli.digest.advice.fix_base: Fix the default branch: confirm the patrol's draft quest if there is one, or fix it yourself; run the trial again to see it green. The item stays until a patrol finds the check green.
messages.cli.digest.advice.read_scan: Not urgent: read the scan's log in .runs/patrol-<territory>/scans/, then fix it or give it to a quest.
messages.cli.digest.advice.unhold_when_ready: Not urgent: the Steward neither claims nor starts it until you lift the hold; it is claimed at the next tick after that.
messages.cli.digest.advice.weigh_triage: Read the letter and the Chancellor's advice, then decide it once (elvaria memo decide), or confirm the draft it names.
messages.cli.digest.advice.settle_objection: Read the objection and the verdict it contests, then decide it once (elvaria memo decide); edit or reassign the quest if the dispute stands.
messages.cli.digest.advice.wait_or_wake: The Steward probes again after the reset; if you just signed in again, wake it now.
messages.cli.digest.advice.watch_mana: Nothing to do yet; elvaria doctor shows the mana gauges.
messages.cli.digest.advice.read_or_revert: No hurry: read the pull request; if the change is wrong, run the undo line on the base branch and push it yourself (the Steward never pushes the base branch).
messages.cli.digest.advice.read_then_resume: No hurry, the work goes on; only every new quest there waits for the seal again. Read what escaped (the quest, its pull request, the red check's log), see it fixed or reverted, then resume the delegation.
messages.cli.digest.advice.check_tribe: Read the CLI's changelog, then run the conformance suite with the real CLI (a few short sessions, a little mana): once it passes, it pins the new version and the tribe works again.
messages.cli.digest.advice.check_tribe_and_restar: Run the conformance suite: it finds the CLI now installed, tries it with the real CLI (a little mana) and pins it once it passes; then restart elvaria run, so the Steward starts the CLI just pinned.
messages.cli.digest.advice.upgrade: Read what changed (git log), then upgrade while no quest runs: it builds, tries and pins the new build, and keeps the current one to roll back to.
messages.cli.digest.advice.read_letters_then_rele: Read the Monk's letters first (elvaria memo show <memo>) and do what they ask (a check, a stronger model), then release it.
messages.cli.digest.advice.add_monk: Add a character of a class of the Monk; with the Temple off, also turn it on in kingdom.json: "schedule": {"temple": {"enabled": true}}. Each run of the Temple spends mana.
messages.cli.digest.advice.enable_temple: Turn it on in kingdom.json: "schedule": {"temple": {"enabled": true}}; the Steward reads it again at its next tick. Each run spends mana: at most one session a day, and one for each suspension.
messages.cli.digest.live_note: Built now from the files and the event log; the digest the Steward writes to digest/ lists the same.
